user.title: Garmin Sync – Connect Account
user.description:
Enter your Garmin Connect credentials and select the sensors to sync.

If your account has two-factor authentication enabled, you will be prompted for a code on the next screen.

data.abwheel_sync: Sync Ab Wheel workouts to Garmin
data.jumprope_sync: Sync Jump Rope sessions to Garmin (one activity per session)
data.migraine_forecast: Migraine forecast from Garmin sleep, HRV and stress (research, not a diagnosis)

mfa.title: Garmin Two-Factor Authentication
mfa.description:
Garmin sent a verification code to **{email}**.

Enter the code below to complete setup.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Garmin
reauth_confirm.description:
Your Garmin session for **{email}** has expired.

Enter your password to reconnect. If two-factor authentication is required, you will be prompted for a code on the next screen.

init.title: Garmin Sync – Options
init.description: Update the sensors to sync. Clear a field to stop syncing it. If your Garmin session expires you will be prompted to re-authenticate.

sync_now.name: Sync to Garmin now
sync_now.description: Immediately pushes the current hydration and weight sensor values to Garmin Connect (values already synced are skipped). Without entry_id, all configured accounts are synced.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional – target a specific Garmin account when multiple are configured.

log_headache.name: Log a headache
log_headache.description: Adds a headache to the log used by the migraine forecast. Without an onset time it starts now. Past headaches can be logged too.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional – target a specific Garmin account when multiple are configured.

end.name: End
end.description: When it ended. Leave empty while it is ongoing.

end_headache.name: End a headache
end_headache.description: Sets the end of the most recent headache that is still open, or of the given one.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional – target a specific Garmin account when multiple are configured.

headache_id.name: Headache ID
headache_id.description: ID from the Headache Log sensor. Default: the open headache.

delete_headache.name: Delete a headache
delete_headache.description: Removes a headache from the log.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional – target a specific Garmin account when multiple are configured.

headache_id.name: Headache ID
headache_id.description: ID from the Headache Log sensor.

refresh_migraine_forecast.name: Refresh migraine forecast
refresh_migraine_forecast.description: Downloads recent sleep, HRV and stress data from Garmin and recomputes the score. Use backfill_days to load more history.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional – target a specific Garmin account when multiple are configured.

backfill_days.name: Backfill days
backfill_days.description: How many past days to (re)check, up to 365.
